validation_basis: Isolated selected-index checkout and pinned environment; existing unrelated evaluation and workbook changes excluded
source_hash_scope: Sorted tracked src/, packages/, scripts/, tests/, config/ plus pyproject.toml, uv.lock and requirements files. SHA256 stream: UTF-8 path + NUL + ASCII byte length + NUL + LF-normalized bytes. Documentation and validation records excluded.
platform_limit: One Windows symlink privilege test is skipped locally; Linux CI executes it. The real Windows ACL helper is tested locally.

exit_criteria.basis: Authored adversarial cases, live rule regression, crypto/access/deadline/source controls; the accepted unobservable replacement is explicitly a counterexample, not a rejected attack
Software and simulated tests pass, but actual independent send-action reviews, real curator-role/custody evidence and an untouched representative holdout have not been supplied
No current independently reviewed qualification dataset; G1/G2 remain unmeasured. Owner examples and authored cases cannot enter independent accuracy denominators
Narrow enrolled Claude Microsoft 365 route, generic Gmail API limitation, external/browser agents, missing inspection, source lag and copied-ID residual risk remain explicit

control_drill.basis: authored software control drill, not independent accuracy data

live_rule_regression.basis: Prior owner-prepared synthetic Claude send, current authenticated audit/publisher/mailbox reads; regression only, not independent accuracy or latency evidence

known_residual_counterexample: A fully unobservable copied-ID replacement can still satisfy the approved corroborated POC rule. Authored tests demonstrate this limitation without counting it as a correctly rejected negative.
data_handling: Source/review bytes and OS identities remain private. Public evidence contains redacted results and capture digests only. Original seven-day raw deadlines are preserved; physical purge remains a later operational gate.
review_method: Engineering self-review plus executable controls; no independent human code or dataset review claimed
next_required_evidence: Independent curator and blind source-action review records
Representative disjoint development/calibration/evaluation cases and actual access/custody proof
Independent G1 non-agent negatives including ordinary automation and G2 supported-agent positives
Frozen-window measurement and explicit route/source coverage before any accuracy release claim
